children: The automotive industry veteran joins from Remsons Industries, bringing over three decades of experience across business leadership, manufacturing and sales

Spark Minda (Minda Corporation Limited) has appointed Amit Srivastava as Chief Executive Officer – SSD and ASEAN Business, strengthening the leadership of its automotive components business. Srivastava joins the organisation after an eight-year stint as Group Chief Executive Officer at Remsons Industries, where he was responsible for leading business operations, driving growth and overseeing domestic and international markets.

During his tenure at Remsons, he led the company's business operations and expansion across markets, gaining experience in managing diverse business portfolios and driving organisational growth. His appointment at Spark Minda brings extensive leadership experience across the automotive and auto components sectors, particularly in business development, manufacturing, sales strategy and profit and loss management.

Before joining Remsons Industries, Srivastava spent more than 12 years at AMW Auto Component Limited, where he led sales, marketing and logistics. His responsibilities included overseeing key commercial functions and driving business operations in the automotive components segment.

He has also held senior positions at Hindalco Industries, Bridgestone Americas and Apollo Tyres. Across these organisations, he has gained experience in business leadership, manufacturing operations, market development and strategic management.

With more than three decades of professional experience, Srivastava's appointment comes as Spark Minda continues to strengthen its leadership across its automotive and component businesses. His experience across domestic and international markets is expected to support the company's SSD and ASEAN business operations, with a focus on business growth, operational performance and market development.
